sinopsis.es: En Malasia, donde ser LGBT está criminalizado, el trans Faris y su banda punk siguen tocando y protestando. Un retrato de valentía, amistad y espíritu punk.
sinopsis.en: Being LGBT is criminalised in Muslim-majority Malaysia. Trans man Faris and his queer friends navigate love, identity, and resistance through the underground punk music scene, finding community in defiance of a society that wants them erased.
